description: Codex: Adeptus Custodes (11e) GOLDEN LIGHT OF THE MOIRAIDES (Dread Host, 2 CP) — WP-C5. Fixture cus11e_c5_active (P1 Custodes active, round 2; layout in tests/helpers/gen_cus11e_c5_fixtures.gd). Setup privileges: the Custodes detachment flipped (stratagems reloaded), auto wound allocation, Trajann's Moment Shackle marked spent (its prompt is not under test), the Custodes unreadied (Martial Ka'tah not under test), straight to the phase under test (Movement phase); P2 has 0 CP (no Fire Overwatch); the Allarus Custodians are put into Deep Strike reserves. In the Movement phase the player picks the Allarus in the movement unit list (the reserves arrival): the new unit_selected_to_ingress window opens BEFORE the placement; a real click on Use spends 2 CP; the placement then starts and three real board clicks + Confirm set the unit up. Until the start of the owner's next turn attacks that target it get -1 to hit and it cannot be targeted by snap shooting (no Fire Overwatch).
